title: Synthetic LFP battery SOC estimator comparison (pilot)
research_question: How do candidate SOC estimators compare in the specified synthetic LFP 1RC simulation?

domain_context.operating_regime: 22% capacity fade, isothermal 25 C, simulated dynamic load; external cell validation not performed
domain_context.note: The context reflects the pilot code/spec and is not a literature-validated operating envelope.

questions.question: What target cell format, chemistry-specific OCV behavior, temperature range, and intended use should define the literature search and model applicability?
questions.why: Bounds and parameter ranges from a different cell or operating regime may not apply.
choices: Keep the current synthetic LFP 1RC scope, explicitly exploratory
Target a named physical LFP cell and operating regime

questions.question: How should the model handle boundary crossing, and should raw pre-clamp SOC plus cutoff events be recorded for each episode?
questions.why: A bounded reported trace alone cannot show whether a numerical clamp altered the physical trajectory.
choices: Reject boundary-crossing episodes and preserve unclipped candidate states
Model and log a validated physical cutoff that prevents boundary crossing

questions.question: Which independent physical-cell dataset and evaluation protocol should be used before making empirical battery-performance claims?
questions.why: Synthetic replay cannot establish validity on physical cells.
choices: Keep claims limited to simulation until a dataset is selected
Select a documented public or user-provided cycler dataset

evidence.claim: Pilot simulation generates SOC trajectories from seeded current profiles and returns the state arrays.
evidence.scope: Internal provenance only; not external validation.

evidence.reference: SOC convention proposed for this assurance profile; domain-owner confirmation pending
evidence.claim: The truth trajectory used for an SOC estimation error claim must remain within the declared physical SOC interval [0, 1].
evidence.scope: Executable pilot check; requires confirmation for the chosen SOC definition and operating regime.

evidence.reference: Frozen experiment spec section 5 and simulator state/measurement time indices
evidence.claim: An estimator update must compare a state at time t with voltage measured for time t; a transition from t to t+1 uses the input at t.
evidence.scope: Executable index contract; confirm exact estimator timing convention in the frozen protocol.

external_validation.note: No independent physical-cell dataset has been evaluated in this pilot.
